digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing (claim, transition write commands)
propositions: Replace hand-rolled argument parsing loops in claim and transition write commands with argparse-backed parser while preserving all observable behavior

Preserve --force semantics: claim bare --force consumes next non-option token or defaults to "(no reason given)"; transition bare --force sets force_reason="" (None only when absent) and does NOT consume following token
Preserve --assignee None-vs-empty-string sentinel: absent argument falls back to default_assignee, explicit empty string clears assignee, value-less flag exits 1
Retain transition._parse_flags as an argparse-backed shim returning identical 5-tuple to unblock three external direct callers in tests

Unknown/extra tokens silently skipped via parse_known_args; retired --force-close keeps exit-1 rejection; abbreviations disabled (allow_abbrev=False); --help remains dispatcher-served from golden help files unchanged
